callPoints: **Record quarter in a hard environment.** Volumes 1.44 mn (+29%), standalone revenue Rs17,244 cr (+37%), EBITDA Rs3,596 cr (+45%), margin 20.9% (+110 bp YoY, +10 bp QoQ), PAT Rs2,983 cr (+42%). Management says supply problems (LPG shortages, West Asia shipping, labour migration, a ransomware attack) cost ~10% of the quarter's volume.

**Costs.** Commodity inflation was ~4.5% of revenue in the quarter (steel +10%, aluminium, platinum and rhodium ~+40%); price rises in April and June covered about half, the weak rupee (Rs94.4 per dollar vs Rs85.6 a year earlier) and cost cuts the rest. Q2 will carry the full inflation, which has spread to electronics, labour, logistics and energy.

**Exports.** Record 732k units and $735 m (40% of revenue); Africa more than doubled (Nigeria ~60% retail share with the Boxer 125 Heavy Duty), Mexico and Brazil strong, 3W exports 100k (+70%). Target: more than 250k units a month from Q2.

**Domestic motorcycles.** Industry +7-8%, all of it above 125cc; Bajaj gained a couple of points of Vahan share in 150cc+ but keeps losing share in 100-125cc, where it says it will 'participate on its own terms'. An all-new 150cc Pulsar and ~10 facelifts by September, two new 125cc brands within FY27.

**EVs.** Electric 2W + 3W were ~30% of domestic revenue at a double-digit EBITDA margin; Chetak +~80% and now EBITDA positive; Chetak capacity 50k a month going to 60k. Capacity for the whole company to rise from 7 mn to 9 mn units a year.

**Subsidiaries.** First full quarter of KTM (its Jan-Mar 2026) in the consolidated accounts; consolidated revenue Rs21,689 cr (+65%), attributable PAT Rs3,226 cr (+46%). BACL: income Rs1,109 cr, PAT Rs227 cr, AUM ~Rs20,000 cr (+70%), ROE >25%.
**Cash.** FCF ~Rs2,300 cr; surplus cash ~Rs21,000 cr at June, then ~Rs10,000 cr paid out in July (Rs150 final dividend + Rs5,633 cr buyback); management expects ~Rs15,000 cr again by March 2027.

bacl.notes: Wholly owned NBFC (incorporated 2021; share capital Rs2,700 cr). AAA-rated by CRISIL, CARE, ICRA and India Ratings (Q3FY26 call). Penetration of Bajaj's domestic retail ~40-45%. Last capital infusion Rs300 cr in Oct-2025 as Tier 2, described by the CFO as 'absolutely the last' needed (Q3FY26 call). Joint statutory auditors from FY27 (asset size above Rs15,000 cr).

ktm.structure: BAIH BV (Netherlands, 100% Bajaj Auto) -> Bajaj Auto International Holdings AG (formerly Pierer Bajaj AG, 100% since 18-Nov-2025) -> 74.94% of Bajaj Mobility AG (formerly PIERER Mobility AG; listed on SIX Swiss Exchange and Vienna) -> 100% of KTM AG (KTM, Husqvarna, GASGAS). Bajaj had invested EUR323 m (Rs2,421 cr) in BAIH BV over the years and in 2025 arranged an EUR880 m equity-and-debt package to pay KTM's creditors' cash quota and restart production (AR FY26). Purchase consideration Rs4,456 cr = Rs524 cr call-option exercise + Rs3,932 cr fair value of the 49.9% already held; Rs953 cr remeasurement gain and Rs646 cr currency-reserve gain booked in Q4FY26 (AR note 46). KTM AG refinanced EUR550 m with JP Morgan, HSBC, DBS and MUFG in Feb-2026 (EUR473 m drawn) and repaid BAIH BV's loans. Consolidated with a one-quarter lag.

history.event: Demerger of the old Bajaj Auto into Bajaj Auto (manufacturing), Bajaj Finserv and Bajaj Holdings & Investment
history.impact: Listed in its present form; BHIL remains the anchor holder (34.2%)

history.event: Stake in KTM built from 14% (2007) through Pierer Bajaj AG; small KTMs designed with Bajaj R&D and made in Chakan for sale worldwide
history.impact: Associate income until FY25; India-made KTM exports

history.event: Chetak relaunched as an electric scooter (212 units in FY20)
history.impact: Chetak sold 3.03 lakh units in FY26, 20.7% of e-scooters

history.event: Export slump: Nigeria (a quarter of exports) and other African and Asian markets hit by devaluation and inflation; Nigeria fell from ~50,000 bikes a month to under 5,000. Buybacks reduced equity by Rs3,094 cr (FY23) and Rs3,931 cr (FY24)
history.impact: Export 2W -25% (FY23) and -10% (FY24); share count from 28.9 cr to 27.9 cr

history.event: Bajaj Auto Credit starts lending; Triumph 400cc bikes (made by Bajaj) launched; Freedom 125, the first CNG motorcycle
history.impact: BACL AUM Rs18,835 cr by Mar-26; Triumph crossed 1 lakh units in ~2.5 years

history.event: KTM AG's insolvency and court-supervised restructuring (production halted until end-July 2025); Bajaj arranges an EUR880 m equity-and-debt package
history.impact: KTM associate loss Rs915 cr in FY25 and Rs634 cr in Q2FY26

history.event: China's heavy rare-earth magnet export curbs disrupt Chetak
history.impact: Chetak volumes constrained in H1FY26; supply restored by end-Sep 2025 with alternate motor designs

history.event: GST on motorcycles up to 350cc cut from 28% to 18%; above 350cc raised from 31% (28% + 3% cess) to 40%
history.impact: H2FY26 demand boom; Bajaj absorbed the rise on KTM/Triumph and launched 350cc versions

history.event: Bajaj takes control of KTM's parent (100% of Pierer Bajaj AG, 74.94% of Bajaj Mobility AG)
history.impact: KTM consolidated from Q4FY26; Rs1,599 cr one-off gains in Q4FY26; minorities now share KTM's losses

history.event: West Asia conflict: LPG shortages, commodity spike, shipping disruption; rupee to ~Rs95 per dollar
history.impact: Inflation ~4.5% of revenue in Q1FY27, offset by price and the rupee

history.event: Centenary payout: 100% of FY26 profit as Rs150 dividend plus Rs5,633 cr buyback at Rs12,000
history.impact: Share count 27.95 cr -> ~27.48 cr; ~Rs10,000 cr paid in July 2026
